segments.speaker: chair
segments.text: Right, let us get started. The main item today is the release plan for the new billing system.

segments.speaker: analyst
segments.text: I have the numbers from last week. Error rates dropped by almost half after the patch went out.

segments.speaker: engineer
segments.text: That matches what we saw in the logs as well.

segments.speaker: chair
segments.text: Good. So are we confident enough to move the launch forward by one week?

segments.speaker: engineer
segments.text: I would rather keep the original date. We still need to finish the load tests on the payment service.

segments.speaker: analyst
segments.text: I agree. One more week of data would also make the report much stronger.

segments.speaker: chair
segments.text: We keep the date. Can you both send me a short summary by Friday?

segments.speaker: analyst
segments.text: Yes, I will have it ready by Thursday afternoon.

segments.speaker: engineer
segments.text: Same here. I will include the load test results if they are finished.
